user.title: Pair a phone

error.not_paired: No phone has used this code yet. Pair it in the app first, then press Submit.

abort.already_configured: This phone was already added. Its pairing has been renewed.

ask.name: Ask a question
ask.description: Shows a question with 2 to 4 buttons in the assistant pill on the phone. Returns the button that was pressed, and fires the phone_speaker_answer event.

options.name: Buttons
options.description: 2 to 4 button labels. The first one is highlighted.

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.description: Seconds before the question disappears. 0 keeps it until answered.

wait.name: Wait for the answer
wait.description: Wait until a button is pressed (or the time runs out) and return the answer. Turn off to continue right away and react to the event instead.

camera.name: Camera
camera.description: A camera to show above the question: a live picture that refreshes every couple of seconds.

media.name: Image or video
media.description: A picture or video URL, or a media source, to show above the question.
